Alex: CI red on main after today's lockfile bump (PR #4123). linux-latest wheel job failing for unit tests. failing test: serializer/test_config.py::test_env_vars_on_load. anyone seen this?
ci-bot: Build 2051234567.2 failed: job=build-wheel-linux; log: ```
ImportError: cannot import name 'parse_uri' from 'rfc3986' (/opt/hostedtoolcache/python/.../site-packages/rfc3986/__init__.py)
``` link: https://ci.redwood/example/build/2051234567
Maria: ack, looking. did we bump rfc3986 in the lock?
Ben: I noticed a transitive update from rfc3986 1.5.0 -> 1.6.0 in the lockfile PR summary. could be API change.
Jordan: can we reproduce locally quickly? Alex, can you paste the failing stack?
Alex: stack snippet: ```
File ".../requests/models.py", line 42, in <module>
from rfc3986 import parse_uri
ImportError: cannot import name 'parse_uri'
``` I can repro in a clean venv with poetry lock --no-update then pip install -r .venv/requirements.txt
Maria: thanks. quick bisect idea: revert the transitive bump in the lock and run CI, or pin rfc3986 back to 1.5.0 in pyproject's [tool.poetry.dependencies] as a temporary fix.
Ben: I'll run a lockfile bisect job (git bisect style) across the lockfile commits to confirm. triggering now: `./scripts/lock-bisect --range=main~10..main --job=linux-wheel`
ci-bot: bisect job queued: job id 7783. status: running.
Jordan: small workaround: add `rfc3986 = "1.5.0"` under [tool.poetry.dependencies] and regenerate lock, or `poetry add rfc3986@1.5.0 --lock` — that'll surface whether the code paths still import parse_uri.
Alex: confirmed pin fixes local repro. I'll open a revert PR for lockfile bump and include the bisect output.
Maria: thanks. action items: Ben to post bisect result, Alex to open revert PR, Jordan to run a quick smoke on staging after revert. :thumbsup:
Ben: bisect finished: culprit commit is 9f3c2b4 — bumped rfc3986 via transitive httpx->rfc3986 1.6.0. uploading bisect log to the ticket.
Alex: filed PR #4189 to pin rfc3986 to 1.5.0 and re-run CI, link: https://git.redwood/pr/4189
ci-bot: PR 4189 CI started: https://ci.redwood/build/4189
Maria: leaving followups in the ticket about long-term fix (dependency override or patch on httpx).
